design_archetype: ORGANIC & PERFORMANCE PRO / SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST TECH

font_sizes.subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg font-normal text-white/80 leading-relaxed
font_sizes.label: text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider

layout_strategy.responsive_architecture: Desktop (lg breakpoint and above): 50/50 Split Screen. Left panel is a cinematic dark electric-blue brand visual with glowing mesh gradient, fiber optic abstract imagery, floating feature pills, live metric badge, and customer quote. Right panel is a clean, hyper-refined white/dark glassmorphic form card centered vertically. Mobile (< lg): Stacked mobile-first hero with compact top brand bar, glowing backdrop, and bottom rounded card with elevated depth.
layout_strategy.outer_container: min-h-screen w-full flex flex-col lg:flex-row bg-slate-950 font-sans text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 overflow-hidden
layout_strategy.left_brand_panel: hidden lg:flex lg:w-[52%] relative flex-col justify-between p-12 lg:p-16 bg-gradient-to-br from-[hsl(222,47%,9%)] via-[hsl(216,100%,18%)] to-[hsl(216,100%,52%)] text-white overflow-hidden
layout_strategy.right_form_panel: w-full lg:w-[48%] flex flex-col justify-between p-6 sm:p-10 lg:p-16 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 relative z-10

visual_enhancers.background_texture: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) + mesh gradient blobs floating with CSS animation keyframes.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism_card: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border border-white/40 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(0,51,255,0.08)] rounded-3xl p-8 sm:p-10
visual_enhancers.input_styling: h-12 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 pl-11 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-[hsl(216,100%,52%)] focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[hsl(216,100%,52%)]/15 transition-all shadow-sm
visual_enhancers.primary_button_styling: h-12 w-full bg-[hsl(216,100%,52%)] hover:bg-[hsl(216,100%,45%)] text-white font-semibold rounded-xl shadow-[0_8px_25px_-4px_rgba(0,51,255,0.45)] hover:shadow-[0_12px_30px_-4px_rgba(0,51,255,0.6)] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2

instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign `/app/frontend/src/pages/Login.js` to implement the pro split-screen layout on desktop and elevated mobile card layout.
Keep all existing state hooks, API integrations (`useAuth`, `api.post('/auth/forgot-password')`, `toast.success`, `toast.error`), and router navigations completely intact.
MUST retain every single `data-testid` attribute exact string as specified in `required_data_testids` list.
Incorporate high visual fidelity with GoRoky's electric blue brand `#0033FF` / `hsl(216 100% 52%)`, glassmorphism, brand feature cards, customer trust badges, and glowing interactive elements.
Add responsive dark/light support or ultra-sleek dark navy & white contrast so the CRM portal looks like a top-tier telecom operator (e.g. Movistar, O2, Digimobil pro UI).
Provide clear back button and success state alert for the forgot password flow.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.do_not_center_app: Do NOT add text-align center globally.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do NOT use `transition: all`. Use target transition properties.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_emoji_icons: Do NOT use emojis as UI icons; rely exclusively on lucide-react icons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testids_mandatory: All interactive elements must retain exact data-testid properties.
